lines.en: Lesson 89
For sale
Listen to the tape then answer this question.
lines.zh: 听录音，然后回答这个问题。

lines.en: Why couldn't Nigel decide?
lines.zh: 为什么奈杰尔不能决定？

lines.en: Good afternoon.
I believe that this house is for sale.
lines.zh: 我想这栋房子是待售的。

lines.en: That's right.
May I have a look at it, please?
Yes, of course.
Come in.
How long have you lived here?
I've lived here for twenty years.
lines.zh: 我在这里住了二十年了。

lines.en: Twenty years!
That's a long time.
Yes, I've been here since 1976.
lines.zh: 是的，我从1976年就住在这里了。

lines.en: Then why do you want to sell it?
lines.zh: 那你为什么要卖掉它呢？

lines.en: Because I've just retired.
I want to buy a small house in the country.
lines.zh: 我想在乡下买一栋小房子。

lines.en: How much does this house cost?
That's a lot of money!
It's worth every penny of it.
Well, I like the house, but I can't decide yet.
lines.zh: 嗯，我喜欢这栋房子，但我还不能决定。

lines.en: My wife must see it first.
Women always have the last word.
